extDescription.message: Send downloads from your browser to your DownloadPulse server.
extDescription.description: Store and manifest description of the extension.

popupNotConnected.description: Toolbar popup: the extension is not connected to a DownloadPulse server.

optionsTitle.description: Title of the extension's settings page.

optionsPlaceholder.description: Settings page body while the extension has no settings.

popupConnect.description: Popup button: start connecting this browser.

popupProbing.description: Popup status while checking this computer or the server.

popupNotFound.message: No DownloadPulse is running on this computer. Start it and check again, or connect to a server.
popupNotFound.description: Popup: nothing answered on this computer.

popupCheckAgain.description: Popup button: look on this computer again.

popupServerLabel.description: Popup: label of the server address field.

popupServerPlaceholder.description: Popup: example in the server address field.

popupConnectServer.description: Popup button: connect to the address entered.

popupWaiting.message: Approve this browser in the DownloadPulse tab that just opened.
popupWaiting.description: Popup status while waiting for the person to approve on the server.

popupCode.description: Popup: precedes the pairing code shown on both sides.

popupCodeHint.message: DownloadPulse shows the same code. Only approve if they match.

popupStartAgain.description: Popup button: back to the start after a failure.

popupConnected.description: Popup status: this browser is connected.

popupServer.description: Popup: label of the connected server's address.

popupAccount.description: Popup: label of the account this browser belongs to.

popupBrowser.description: Popup: label of the name this browser was given.

failureUnreachable.message: That server can't be reached. Check the address and that DownloadPulse is running.

failureCertificate.message: That server can't be reached securely. If it uses its own certificate, open it in a tab, accept the certificate, then connect again.
failureCertificate.description: Popup error: an HTTPS server failed, possibly a self-signed certificate.

failureNotDownloadPulse.message: Something answered at that address, but it isn't DownloadPulse.

failureTooOld.message: This DownloadPulse is too old to connect browsers. Update it, then connect again.
failureTooOld.description: Popup error: the server lacks the browser protocol.

failureDenied.message: The connection was denied in DownloadPulse.

failureExpired.message: The connection request expired. Start again.

failurePermission.message: The browser didn't allow access to that server.
failurePermission.description: Popup error: the person declined the site access prompt.

failureUnauthorized.message: DownloadPulse no longer accepts this browser. Connect it again.
failureUnauthorized.description: Popup error: the token was refused.

failureFailed.message: Something went wrong while connecting. Start again.

pairingClientName.description: The name a browser connection is given by default, for example 'Firefox on Linux'. The person can change it when approving.
